review.note: No spacecraft has ever visited Quaoar; not part of Solar System Scope's illustrative dwarf-planet set (checked live 2026-08-27). Procedurally generated surface parameterized from Jewitt & Luu 2004 (crystalline water ice + ammonia-hydrate/methane detection, indicating recent cryovolcanic resurfacing): light cratering plus brighter ice-patch regions, same reasoning as Orcus above.
